mapper.select: SELECT id, household_id, parent_id, name, sort_order FROM categories WHERE household_id = #{householdId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (household_id, parent_id, name, sort_order) VALUES (#{householdId}, #{parentId}, #{name}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM categories WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND id = #{id}
